tbesh_html:
1) to moan, growl, utter, muse, mutter, meditate, devise, plot, speak
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to roar, growl, groan
1a2) to utter, speak
1a3) to meditate, devise, muse, imagine
1b) (Poal) to utter
1c) (Hiphil) to mutter

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to murmur (in pleasure or anger); by implication, to ponder
strongs_1890.kjv_def: imagine, meditate, mourn, mutter, roar, [idiom] sore, speak, study, talk, utter.
